definitions.name: FpFiniteStructure
definitions.summary: The constructed prime-order structure combines actual operation tables, a p-element bijection, proved field laws and exact characteristic. Its existence is a theorem; extension fields of order p^k remain a separate open goal.

external_dependencies.name: add_assoc

external_dependencies.name: add_comm
external_dependencies.statement: forall n m. n + m = m + n
